title: Roasted Comte Pasta
description: A simple yet flavorful pasta dish featuring roasted comte cheese and an array of herbs.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
While the pasta cooks, toss the comte cheese with olive oil, thyme, rosemary, and garlic on a baking sheet.
Roast the comte cheese in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the cooked pasta.
Add the reserved pasta water to the roasted comte cheese and toss to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the cheese mixture and toss until well coated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
